articles.title: Baird Cut Its Qualcomm Target to $320. It Still Sees 104% Upside
articles.description: Key TakeawaysBaird cut its Qualcomm price target to $320 from $400 after the fiscal fourth-quarter report and kept its Outperform rating. Qualcomm’s phone chip sales are shrinking as Apple moves to its own modems, while its data center chips start shipping to Amazon and a second hyperscaler.
